The folks at CoPilot couldn’t leave well enough alone, and figured now that you know how the app works, let’s change everything so you won’t have a clue how to use it. title: Rage Bait
body: I’m 90% sure this is the same CoPilot GPS Navigation system that my work uses and oh my lord is this the worst navigation system to ever exist. Been using it for over 2 years at my job and it still gets me just as mad as my first time using it. The addresses are extremely inaccurate, it recalculates your route if you move a millimeter in the wrong direction, when it designs a route it’ll take you back and forth a lot, and its line of travel is absolutely ridiculous. An example is it can direct you to take a lap around a neighborhood for one street over you’ve just made a left for. I can’t tell you how much time I’ve wasted with this junk. I wish we used Apple Maps, Google Maps, literally anything else other than this garbage but I’m pretty sure the company I work for uses the cheapest junk available including this program.

title: Completely Broken
body: I have used copilot for over 6 years now as a truck driver, 3 on iOS (iPad mini 4) and then 3 on android devices. I purchased a 2022 iPad to replace my Samsung tablet. So far, being back on iOS is a total failure… my account purchases won’t link over, despite using the same login info. My settings and favs come over just fine, but my subscription won’t come over no matter what I do. Reached out to copilot directly and 5 days later, it’s still silent with no replies. Kind of pointless to pay for something and not be able to use it, though my subscription still works perfectly on my Samsung tablet. When I moved from iOS to android 3 years ago, I did NOT have issues with it transferring over. Past that the gps lock that works perfectly with apple and google maps on iOS fail completely in copilot, and it did NOT use to be that way on my mini 4. Copilot will show my location fine, until I start to move…but the gps location shows sitting still, even after 600 miles… I left it on and running hoping it would start moving, but it never did. The ui scaling is also broken entirely. Android version got a major refresh a few months ago with proper scaling for tablet screens, but this version has no scaling, nor has it received the ui refresh. The refresh is not perfect, and has its own issues on android, but the iOS version on here is so large that you are better off using your phone than staring at elements that take up literal inches of screen space where they should take a fraction of the space… the way they use to over 3 years ago on my mini 4. Right now copilot is a total failure on thimbles part, and the iOS version USE TO BE so good! If you have NO OTHER option than to use this app, avoid the iOS version at all cost until things get fixed and use it on android instead. Trimble! Get your act together and fix the iOS version, AND subscription crossover between OS’s.

title: Finally giving up
body: I’ve used this app for more than five years. I loved that the maps are resident on the phone because I regularly traveled where there’s no cell. I put up with an occasional goofy routing through a narrow residential street when an arterial was nearby. I loved that the map doesn’t try to be helpful by zooming around at every freeway intersection. But starting three years ago my subscription cancelled itself before it really expired. Tech support blamed Apple. An hour with an Apple guru couldn’t find an issue. I finally deleted the app and bought a new subscription using a new email and Apple ID. Next year same problem (just road out a few weeks with no maps). And next year. This year it won’t load anything but a map (no active traffic that’s paid for, no access to my address book, no search). Just a basic paper map (starting mid January) for a subscription that doesn’t end until March 1, leaving me without maps in a part of the USA with no cell (so Apple and Google maps won’t work). I’m done.

title: Horrible for trucks
body: GPS is always out of date even when it’s updated. Constantly wrong locations, wrong road designations, speed limits, etc… Directions are the worse, example current highway requires a left hand turn to stay on, but GPS says keep left to stay on current highway. This is a constant problem with this app. The exits numbers are correct on the app, but the GPS directions don’t match the road signs. It doesn’t tell you what lane to be in to make an exit or to keep on the highway you have to make a guess and hope you’re correct. It doesn’t actively tell you how far you are from the next town or city on your current route or the nearest truck stop. This is valuable information if you are a truck driver to have when you are out on the road. Over all I would give this GPS an F- it seems like it was developed for a quick buck and not for accuracy or safety of truck drivers or the general public. Do not use this app if the following applies to you. 1. You value your own safety 2. You value your employees safety 3. You value the safety of the general public Trimble is a useless software company and all of their products are cheap and worthless.

title: Trip sharing
body: My wife is a school bus driver. I set up an account for her on my phone and added all her stops for her. When I logged in on her phone the trip wasn’t there and it seems like there’s no way to share it. No way to share trips? That seem like a basic function. What a super inconvenience.

title: Dangerous errors
body: I expect much more from a company who’s main goal is to avoid dangerous situations for people pulling trailers, driving campervans or 18-wheelers. Even though I input my dimensions prior to setting out, it directed me through small villages instead of main roads, one of which I almost didn't get out of because it was too narrow. It took me an hour and detaching my boat trailer by hand to get out of that situation with only minor damage. Further on the app alerted me erroneously that I was over the speed limit for about an hour. The data sources and logic used in Europe steer users into trouble.

title: Delete!
body: We have 40 ft diesel when searching for fuel stops it list gas stations not convenient for rv.

title: Junk, unless you like towns
body: Used the app, while on trial, but this junk app led us thru a town with tight turns, one way streets, and low treed streets. Towing a 43 foot rv, wasnt fun at all. Not sure why but gee, highway wasn’t far away. I’ll keep looking

title: Use
body: I understand the want to restrict some functions of the app but to have everything restricted unless you buy into premium is a bit excessive. The app is useless unless you buy into it.

title: Disappointing to say the least
body: I am so incredibly disappointed with this service. It is hard to find a dependable RV safe GPS, and after trying out CoPilot, I decided to give it a try and swing for the full $30 membership (which is a bit pricey in my opinion). Then, a month ago I got a new phone and had trouble transferring over my membership to the new device. After chatting with customer service a few times, they told me that because I switched from an android to an IPhone, that my license could not transfer over. Okay, fine, but can you still honor my membership for the rest of its lifetime? No. Can I have a discount to buy another membership? No. Is there anything that you can do? No. They told me to buy a new membership and brushed me off like I wasn’t one of their paying customers. As I said, extremely disappointing and maybe the worst customer service I’ve ever dealt with. Avoid at all costs if you don’t like being scammed.

title: Unreliable
body: This app constantly takes us on routes that our RV has no business being on. Countless times bridges have been low without warning. Today it took us down a narrow road in our 43 foot RV causing us to bottom out and cause major damage to our leveling system. Do not pay for this app unless you want to spend even more on rv damages.

title: Wrong way
body: We are next to a well known RV/Truck unfriendly road marked with signs for trucks to turn around. There is a RV save road about a mile away in other direction. Tested app by having it send to town on other side. It failed would have sent us down worst part of road.

title: New update Not Working
body: The new update Not working correctly not letting put in the address fix issue

title: No android auto or car play support
body: Company says they are concerned with drivers safety but having to look at your phone when driving rather than a 8” screen seems silly. Most will just use an app that work. Copilot’s loss. Update, it’s been long enough. I have had the paid version of this app for 5 years. Have been waiting almost 2 years for CP support so today I deleted it. Too many other choices out there to bother with this.

title: Route selection problems
body: I downloaded this because of Youtube recommendations for RV routing. Our first experience was not happy. We were first routed into a tunnel which we were not supposed to enter due to propane tanks, then routed to a parkway where RV’s aren’t allowed. Not much advantage to using unless I’m missing something. I selected RV and entered size and height information.

title: Piece of crap!
body: It worked while I had the free trial version but once I paid the $29.99 for the paid version, it stopped working. I am traveling in my 13’4” 5th wheel and needed navigation to get us to our destination that would not take us under low bridges, etc. I ended up having to download and pay for another app because this one wouldn’t even pull up a map. Complete waste of money.

title: No CarPlay support
body: Routes are good. UI is nice. But it’s useless without Apple CarPlay support. I’m not going to buy a mount to mount my phone on the dash when I have a nice big screen built in.

title: Wishing I would have not purchased
body: Using the app last Memorial weekend on my way to my destination the directions had me driving a 40 motor home through an area that basically was a drug area in small neighborhood streets. Then on the way home it got worse when people were yelling at me to not go down similar streets. I deleted the app. Don’t waste your money. Unfortunately there is not a 0 star option

title: Where are we going!
body: Out in your RV and ready for a frustrating trip. Do you unintentionally want to explore on roads too small for a horse and buggy? The excitement of been directed up a road with a bridge you cannot go through or under? Roads so narrow you cannot turn off them or go back? THIS IS THE APP FOR YOU! Despite having it set for a total length of 60 feet, width of 8’5” and height of 11’6” this app has lead us into dangerous situations (above) each of the three times we have used it. It is disgraceful that they get your money and you get stuck, do not buy this map, any other map is better.

title: crApp
body: Another subscription based crApp. Just a money-grab for something that only needs a one-time purchase.

title: Don’t waste your money on this App
body: I would give this zero stars if I could. The reason I bought this was to avoid roads that don’t allow camp trailers or campers. The app didn’t allow me the free 14 day trial for navigation, so I had to spend $29.99. I put in our camp trailer height, etc. and the very first trip That I routed was going to put us on a road in CT (Rt 15 Merritt Parkway) that I know for a fact does not allow trailers or campers, etc. due to low underpasses and tight exit ramps, etc. it would have been a nightmare if we weren’t familiar with that road. Therefore, we can’t trust this app at all. My suggestion: don’t waste your money and save yourself a possible nightmare experience.

title: Used to be good
body: I’ve had this gps for years, and have recommended it to many other drivers for route and trip planning.However, their latest update, they made it easier to type in an address, but now I cant search for fuel, parking, or any other important stops along my route, like I could before. It’s not working correctly. I sent an email about this. They replied “ The functionality that you refer to is not currently available in CoPilot …. it has already been identified as a potential enhancement for future releases and is currently under consideration for inclusion by our product managers.” Wth? This “future enhancement” of seeing fuel and things along my route worked fine before, but now your app has become useless. It has already caused me trouble trying to stick with this app, and not being able to see simple truck stops along my route, if this bug isn’t fixed very soon I’m going to have to cancel subscription and switch to another gps.

title: Very disappointing
body: Not user friendly. Seems as though it should be simple. First time trying to use for a destination 130 miles away. It says it’s an 8hour trip. Makes no sense. Wasted $29.99

title: Ruined my MAIN reason for using this app - use offline. !!! B A D !!
body: Now find must log in to use it. Cant without internet !!! B AD !!

title: Awful
body: Both the campground and street address databases are incomplete to the point of worthlessness.

title: Gets worse every year
body: I only use this app when traveling in my motor home because of the gps and height settings. So every several months, I update and hit the road. It has so many bugs. Turns me in circles, gives broken turn announces. I don’t trust it anymore. Moved to Waze. I want my money back!

title: I want my money back
body: or we go to court

title: I can’t even log back in
body: I reset my password and it sends me the email confirmation and everything. But then when I go login it tells me the username is not associated. So annoying that we have to pay for a broken app or service. Everything was working great for years

title: Not reliable. Got me into trouble
body: It seems they aren’t updating this app accurately. To start I was experiencing several incidences where this app did not recognize the address I entered and would give me another option nearby. But I could accept this, however there were several times using this app that it would freeze and not update. And unless I was paying attention I could have missed a turn or something important. In order to overcome the freeze I would have to force close the app and reopen/ load it. That’s a concerning issue with regards to confidence of the product. But my topper to canceling my subscription and deleting the app was the directions it gave me to get on the freeway to other night, it instructed me to turn left so I was in the left lane pulling 70’ of Coach and trailer . It wasn’t till I neared the point where there should have been a left turn lane that I realized the app is wrong and I was supposed to have been on the right side of the road 3 lanes over to a helix on-ramp. And it became clear this on-ramp system had been there for many many years. I was left with having to navigate through small streets and come back around. For me, A subscription based app focused on trust for driving directions, it was a fail on a gargantuan level. No go for me Copilot. You aren’t worthy.

title: Worst app ever made
body: If I could give it zero stars I would. First time using it it send me down back roads with low trees and no clearance. The actual route was perfect highway and open main roads with no low trees or bridges. The roof of my brand new RV got bashed. People use this app to avoid this and instead it lead me to damage my camper. Don’t use this app.

title: Won’t download maps
body: I have plenty of storage on my iPhone. Says I don’t have enough room. So I picked a smaller regional map. It let me try and download the Eastern Map. BUT the download wouldn’t even start. Can’t even try this out

title: Height
body: I have been asking the people who run this App for months to fix an issue regarding height of my RV and they seem either incapable or just outright unwilling to fix this issue. The max height in the App is 13’ and many 5th wheels are 13’5” height same as trucks. Numerous emails back and forwards from the “tech support” section promising they will fix this issue and they never have. No longer paying for a premium subscription for an inferior product that this company is obviously incapable of resolving. Do not get this app if you have a max height rig

title: Scam
body: Do not download and buy. Everytime I close app for a few days and come back it’s prompts me to buy again. Or deletes your whole account

title: Do not buy if you have an RV taller than 13 feet
body: It wont allow for RV heights greater than 13 feet and also doesn't work on Apple car play.

title: Not what I expected
body: After reading some reviews I decided to try a subscription to CoPilot GPS. I wish now that I didn’t waste my $30.00. The app couldn’t find any of the addresses I put in, the app stopped navigating mid-trip which created all kinds of confusion, and the interface is clunky and hard to navigate. I was really hoping to find an app that did a good job with RV navigation, unfortunately this isn’t the one. How do I get my $30.00 back? I would love a refund.

title: A good app, but terrible support!
body: I’ve been using the app for about a year and it has never issued a bad instruction. It’s multiple route to choose from and the traffic features are a real winners. The problem comes when you try to reach someone at the developer for tech support. They are slow to respond, don’t answer your question and leave you high and dry. My subscription is still with in the one year I paid for, but the app is back to basic mode and asking me to pay again. A simply fix for them, you’d think, but no. It’s been 3 days and now the weekend is here and I have no option but to repurchase something for which I’ve already paid. I rely on this app to assist me in safely and reliably doing my job and have communicated that to them, but have been ignored. So buy this app with the knowledge that you may be on your own. Same problem again!! Absolute rubbish support!!!

title: Stuck on locating gps
body: Doesn’t use gps. Permissions given

title: No Height Over 13’ Allowed
body: My RV is 13 feet, 5 inches tall and the app will not let me enter a height over 13 feet. This is DANGEROUS because it could route you under bridges and overpasses that are too low. We almost had this happen yesterday. Thankfully we had ONE INCH of clearance. I’m stopping my use of the app until it can be proven to work for the height of my RV.

title: Does not work
body: App cannot find addresses by zip or full address. Tried to enter several address and nothing was found

title: RV Profile removed
body: I bought the maps because this was one of the few RV profile (enter height for your rig) enabled apps. The website and App Store description still state it’s fir RVs put I only get car, motorcycle or bicycle profiles now? Feel like bait and switch after buying maps and features (lifetime) They responded to my review but I bought the maps because this was an rv app. The developers updated their support site rv access is now paid annually, but I didn’t buy the app because it had a subscription model, I know more and more apps are going this way but they didn’t update the App Store overview or their product website. To me this is sloppy and just signs of a lazy development company.

title: Beware
body: I am currently on the 15 day trial period. I used the App on a route from Florida to Tennessee and it sent me about 70 mile across Florida on back roads and on a street through a subdivision. This app is not for me driving a 38’ motor home. I’ve also tried to cancel the free trial but can not find the “manage my account” location. I’ve went to my copilot gps account but there is no link to “manage my account”. There are instructions on how to cancel your paid subscription but Free trial, no. I have sent copilot gps an email requesting directions but I’ve received no response.

title: Unusable, unsearchable
body: The most recent forced upgrade removed the ability to search for a location, rendering this silly app unusable. Trimble now forces you to pay for voice navigation just to get basic address searching that better apps offer for free. Deleted.

title: Not working at all
body: I tried to start account and it just stays on the data input screen. “Continue” stays grayed out. Enter and deleted data several times. I wish apple would get rid of non functioning apps. I couldn’t even see any part of the app.

title: Not impressed
body: It works mostly ok but the interface is clunky and difficult to use. Following the driving directions is not straight forward and in driving directions stop a block away from the destination. There are much better gps apps available

title: What a joke. Removing the app right now
body: I just downloaded the 14 day trial and I entered a destination just to have us doing a U-turn a block down from our house. There is no need for a u- turn.

title: Scary reroute
body: Traveling with our RV so we were concerned about height restrictions thinking we’d give this app a try. Well I’m glad we had our atlas and roadmap because the app kept telling us to reroute and turn around (quite adamantly I might add) . Took my map out and sure enough it was bringing us to a northern version of the street we input in a different state despite my correct state input. Would have taken us oh about 100 miles out of our way. Freaked my husband out so much he won’t use the app again. $30 wasted

title: Poor interface, very clunky
body: Not intuitive at all, very limited searching for locations via map, have to know the specific address to find something, "search the Internet" wouldn't find OK City airport. Delete.

title: Complete lack of real time support
body: App is telling me my subscription expired today after being in use most of the day. Current time is 1500 central. I have an apple receipt showing it was renewed 4 days ago. Trying to get support is an absolute joke. I finally found a number to their parent company and was told copilot only has email support. Finding how to send that email took another 20 minutes and I had to fill out the support ticket in French. I’m going to search for alternatives.

title: Horrible
body: Not intuitive. Cannot get my correct vehicle height in the app. I was informed it could show low bridges. If the app does this, then I can’t get it to work. Also I keep having to restore my subscription. Geez.

title: Can’t register
body: Error after error, can’t get passed the main screen to register. Keeps saying invalid copilot id.

title: Took us down a dead end road, not a KOA
body: Heading to a KOA right off the freeway. App took us down the frontage road that ended five miles before the campsite. Not helpful to new RV owners that are learning to handle a rig. Won’t be completing the free trial or paying for this.

title: Totally confused
body: This is the most confusing of all the travel apps I’ve tried. Total waste of my money. I do not recommend this app.

title: Frustrated
body: First, it USA great app when it works. I have used it for several years and had automatic renewal and I really like it. Unfortunately now when I try to use the search I am told it is a premium feature. One I’ve already paid for. I use the refresh feature, no change. I then try to log in and have to reset my password. Then it says I don’t have a registered product. My subscription was good through August. No good trying to “contact” anyone. I’m done. Can’t recommend it any longer.

title: Traffic
body: I paid for the traffic add on. On my iPhone. I love it on my phone. I drive approx 50k miles a year in and around NYC. I like to use my iPad when driving my work minivan. Have a nice holder for it so no distractions. When I sign in with the same account, I can not get the traffic info on my iPad. I says I must sign up, even though I already paid for Active traffic

title: Hachers,?
body: Alright...I have patience, Dear Lord... Attempted to register and sign in Nada. Taken down a dead end alley. Shared my email. Alright... And suggested my Password Nothing. Nada. Wondering if these guys are ...scammers/hackers fishing for passwords

title: Can’t find address
body: Typed in two addresses and it couldn’t find either. One I eventually found, but the app misspelled it and the other it just couldn’t find. Google maps had no trouble on either.

title: Fails at Main Job
body: There are aspects of this app that I like. However, the main issue, and why I will no longer use it, is that it has failed multiple times to do the main thing that I got it for amd that is to avoid routes based on trailer length and height. I felt like it was worth paying the $30 for this exact feature. Otherwise, I could use Google Maps for free. This most recent time it took me right down the middle of the strip in Laughlin, NV. Come to find out, I could have stayed on a highway and avoided the tight space and traffic and been faster. Since being at this RV park I have noticed the highway route is what every other RV has taken to get here. After arriving my wife put the trip into Google Maps and it routed along the highway as well. It also often times doesn’t have the address I am looking to go to or the place by name. I could live with that, but I cannot live with it leading me on a route that is more dangerous/difficult due to our length. Again, this is supposed to be the whole reason to pay to get it. Disappointed that I wasted my money on this product.

title: Can’t enter in addresses
body: I found this app utterly useless. I can’t enter in my destination address, because it automatically changes to an arbitrary address starting with similar numbers, but on an entirely different road in an entirely different state. When I tried to search my destination using other methods, it was not found. I must say I am rather disappointed.

title: Darrel the trucker
body: This app worked fine for a couple of years. Been trying for the last two weeks to load it on a new phone. No luck. I’m gonna permanately delete. I am not impressed.

title: DEVELOPER NOT TRUSTWORTHY
body: Paid $65 for a visually and inconsistently reliable app - now it’s basically free and now that I’ve re-downloaded it, they want me to again pay for the few additional features avail for subscription. Delete. *** Be sure to read all of the most recent reviews - we all share in this frustration. Also, their responses to issues are robotic and state no plans for CarPlay

title: Beware business practices.
body: I purchase one of the app when they first lunch. To use with RV. It was working all the way until last week out the blue it keeps on saying no route found. It just stop working. Now it’s subscription base. It’s good to see how they treat people who show support in the sine the beginning. I should have delete out my iPad. Now I can’t get it back.

title: Terrible
body: I purchase this app and the in-app $29.99. I was not able to use it. It is not letting me enter my destination address. It keeps on logging me out! It is so frustrating. I tried doong it in my home wifi hoping the signal is better, but is still the same. I want my money back. Do not ever get this app. Its a ripped off!

title: Does not work!
body: I needed this to work and it took forever to get a GPS signal. It worked for 5 seconds and then it conked out. Thank God I managed to get home, but no love for this app. Do better

title: Do not buy
body: I bought this today and it's already locked me out and won't let me use the app and is trying to make me pay again. Waste of money.

title: Top rated??
body: After seeing multiple articles saying this is the best GPS app for RV driving a plopped down the annual subscription. This app is a joke. - constant crashing, just when entering an address - horrible UX. Like horrible. Totally unintuitive design. Can’t save a trip and see total time between each spot, looks for route alternatives, etc. just a few of the things that made me scream at my phone is disbelief The sad thing is, can’t find an app that replaces it.

title: Issues
body: After i renew it says that i can’t use it on another device never had sny issues before might consider just to cancel if issue not solved.

title: KEEPS LOSING GPS SIGNAL and Freezes
body: I used this app three times and each time multiple times during my trip the app would freeze searching to find a GPS signal. But WAZE was working at the same time on the same phone and had a signal. When COPILOT did finally get a signal it kept finding us on the road next to the highway telling us to make turns to get back to the road I was already on. When my subscription ends I don’t think I will be renewing. So I’m going to start looking for another GPS for routing us with our travel trailer.

title: Stay away.
body: Don’t use this app. Let’s count the ways why... 1. it crashes frequently. 2. Audio commands come too late. 3. Audio commands say go one way, map displays another. 4. Gets lost along your trip and automatically re-routes without telling you. 5. If you miss your stop, which WILL happen with this garbage, it will take yo on an extremely convoluted trip back to where you are supposed to be. And there are more... And yes, I have spent HOURS going through the setting trying to get this thing to behave correctly.

title: Keeps telling me to subscribe
body: I already pay the monthly subscription, but it keeps telling me to upgrade. I can’t restore my licenses and use the features. It works fine on my iPhone, but my iPad it keeps telling me to subscribe even though it’s the same iCloud account.

title: Don’t buy
body: Garbage don’t get this app , koa address don’t show up, one or two I get but three addresses in row this app can’t find ! No thanks stay away

title: Cost?
body: Can’t find anywhere there required cost of this App after the 14 day trial period.

title: I give up
body: I’ve spent about an hour trying to setup my trip. I’ve got the route set, but how in the world do I add in sight-seeing and places to stay? I put in one address and It could not find it. I’m on my trial so I hope you don’t charge my account. I’ll be deleting this app real soon. I’ll just wait to see if I get any answer.

title: Freezing issues
body: I have been using CoPilot sense 2005 and have always recommended to other RV’ers, it’s always worked very well for my 45 Motorhome until yesterday I updated my maps and now my Sat connection goes on & off and the display freezes, I have tried a reset on my iPad re checked all my settings but nothing works. I’m writing this review hoping someone will reply. Traveling I95 South from Ma to Fl

title: iOS 12
body: I have tried several times to install on my new iPhone (I had to delete from the old iPhone as not enough memory). I get as far as map download OKAY but then it freezes on the vehicle dimensions screen. I have used Copilot for many years.

title: Really Dangerous
body: Sent me 3 miles down a dead end back road road with no turn around available and no signs saying it was a dead end. Had to back my 33 foot camper out the whole way. Come to find out it was someone’s private driveway to farm land. Not happy and want my money back!

title: Needs to be Apple Carplay compatible
body: This app has something going but it goes from a 5 star to a 1 star because it does not support apple car play. Very disappointed as I wanted this to be the one.

title: Crashes when selecting to add address
body: Issues with crashing every time I click Address it crashes. I need this app I’m a professional driver.

title: When it's working 100% I love it.
body: I've only had small annoyances with the app; tech support was slow and we're not able to resolve either issue. The first issue was my location marker was the size of dime. I did a from scratch rebuild on the iPad and that resolved it. The second issue was current, active traffic has not worked for around a year. They were not able to resolve that issue either. Today I installed the new app,, transferred the settings and I had 12 days left on active traffic. I paid the $9.99 for another year to save the trouble of getting them to take action. At first.the app was buggy as heck but it's pretty good now. Outside of slow and In infective tech support I like the app. However, I am currently not purchase the trucking add on.... So I guess I'll go without it. I use google maps for active traffic and backup routing. I guess I could just use google but there are features I don't want to go with out. I've been using the app for several years.

title: Incorrect routing
body: The app with traffic is routing us thru a closed construction zone. It’s been closed for months!

title: Very unintuitive
body: I found this very difficult to use. It’s not easy to pick a route; I was frustrated every time I tried to use the app. The search options are terrible.

title: Don’t waste your mind money
body: First day we used it was a 7 hour 350 mile trip. Consistently lost its bearing and it spat out dozens of deviations from our strait forward route. Warned me repeatedly I was going up to a 100mph while cruising at 65. Clunky all around. My confidence level in this product is zero and I’m out $29

title: Not as good as it once was
body: I have used Copilot RV for the past 5 years. It was the best out there in terms of customization and routing of any app. I loved it! Then it changed in 2019 and the preferences became few and the routing has been less than optimal. Works great on the Expressways and most US routes, but secondary highway routing has gotten worse. While we were vacationing in the western US, This lastest version was routing us down dirt forest roads instead of the paved highways. Several times it routed us through exits on the expressway for no known reasons. I have had enough. Opened a support ticket a month ago with no response. I filed a claim today for a refund through Apple. I’m done with Trimble.

title: App does not function well
body: I have paid for this app, set up the personal info, and went to use it at a later date and it acts like I am not subscribed to it. When I click on subscribe again, it says already subscribed then it gives me an error message and I can only use the free version. I have deleted the app, reloaded it twice with the same ultimate results. I want to like this app but so far I have spent $29.99 for nothing and have not been able to use it yet. Very disappointed so far.

title: Just in time for Halloween! Trucker tested Trucker Not approvedHorrable
body: I had such High hope's for this, Not going to bore people with details. Just wish there was another mapping system not reliant on apples bull-crap and googles bull-crap! Sadly not impressed with Co-Pilot!

title: Car Play? No? Really!?!
body: App seems pretty good and new pricing structure seems to be a big improvement but no CarPlay? I have seen this requested by many other users for over 2 years now. I am an avid RV’r and have had an eye on the product. I look for many of the features it has, such as height/clearance data. I am also a tech person by trade and cannot believe that a product of this category and with this popularity has not made it work with CarPlay yet. Just lazy and for that reason I will not purchase the full product. Let me know when CarPlay is FINALLY available. I will buy it then, along with MANY others I am sure. Listen to your customer base.

title: Worst GPS App
body: Guided us in 40’ RV to washed out dirt road with steep sharp turns only a mile from interstate ending up in the same place. Awful. Also, lacks basic functionality of Google Maps and other free products. Consistently suggested longer routes than other free apps for no reason. Awful.

title: BUG!!! can’t change height
body: My rv is 13 ft 6 in. Every time I try to change the height the app removes the inches and resets the feet to 13 regardless of what I change it to. I tried changing it to 14 ft because I figured that would work but it was once again set to 13. Please fix!!!!!!

title: How do I cancel subscription??
body: Can’t find anywhere on app where to cancel subscription. I don’t really use so it’s money I don’t need to spend. Thought there would be something in settings, but there isn’t.

title: Trickery
body: I love the way they allow you to download and set everything up and the hit you with the $15 charge for the app.

title: Bad experience x2
body: We have used this app for our RV travels several times and will not be using anymore. It has taken us to several dirt roads the last one almost cost us our RV. Don’t trust it. It may get you to your destination but will lead you where you should not be to get there.

title: Didn’t change directions for hills that had 4 ton limit
body: We are newbies to RVing. We are planning our 1st trip and tried out CoPilot. It is sending us down a road with 4ton limit. I know this because it is at the end of our street. title: Rv not showing up
body: I have reinstalled copilot gps 3 times and the rv profile is not listed how do I reset to make it rv in the old app every was listed and not rv is missing unusable not

title: Took me to a dead end
body: My first time using this app and i used it to get to and from a state park in Tennessee. It got me there fine but when leaving it took me down a completely wrong turn and straight to a dead end. title: Unreliable
body: I bought this years ago & was annoyed that my purchase didn’t count for anything when it moved to a subscription model. However, I need a reliable GPS on my phone for our RV travels. This isn’t it. On the first trip while using it Copilot directed us down a road that we should never have been on. I don’t blindly follow GPS instructions but neither Apple Maps nor my paper map indicated anything to raise alarms. After we turned into this narrow country road with swamp each side and no shoulders we reached a sign saying that there was no access for vehicles over 1/2 ton or longer than 20 feet. We’re 16 tons and 40 feet and there was no area to turn around. Backing half a mile down a country road to turn back into a busy state highway was great fun. Copilot wouldn’t reroute. It kept telling us to turn back onto that road. The second time, it routed us onto city streets that had low (very low, one was 9’) overpasses. Luckily, I picked up on that before we turned off. Then the app wouldn’t reroute. Third & last time, I ran copilot concurrently with MapQuest, and ran Apple Maps on the iPad alongside. Copilot lost signal and ran around in circles, then tried to turn us around to start the route over. Neither of the others lost our position. Copilot is now uninstalled and I wouldn’t recommend it to any truck or RV driver.

title: New update, but still so bad it’s dangerous
body: I have used this navigation system as a company driver for one year. The danger comes from routes under low bridges. TN 7 in Ardmore is an example of low bridges. This app said go under this bridge. The system seems to always default to routing off the interstate onto city streets then back onto the interstate. The app regularly routes through streets marked as “no trucks”. If there is a truck route that you need to follow, this app will not follow it. The app usually says “take ramp and merge left” instead of turn right. There are NO truck entrances in the application. You will always be directed to the front door. Or it tries to get you to the center of the building. Annoyances are keep left or right as the interstate bears right or left for no purpose. “Use the left two lanes to stay on interstate xx” is what it says when there is an exit with two lanes exiting. Railroad crossings are noted in the app. However the distance is in yards, not miles or feet. It also misses several crossings or tells you of one phantom crossing halfway between two actual crossings “High Risk Rollover” areas are also in yards. The app also tells you all or them near your route, even if they are not on your route. The app does not tell you about traffic lights or stop signs like google or Apple Maps. Some positive elements are that it always shows the speed limit. It has the truck speed limit when there is a difference. Maps are clearly marked with adequate detail. However they do not show bridge weight or clearance information. Some of the text is too small to read.

body: Where do I begin? Well, this app is like most in the app store, basically a waste of time. I drive big rigs and this product has proven to be useless. I know it will give you three different routing options however, neither is a shorter mileage or time option this is not good for a driver who is on a deadline. The graphics are just mediocre and could be better and the maps themselves are not up to date. This app needs a lot of improvements. It's certainly not worth what they want for a subscription. The 14-day trial is nice I didn't make it past using it for three days before I deleted the app.

title: I have been using this app for years but…
body: Recently the app sent me thru a road in New Mexico (NM 126) that should be marked impassible for RV from mile marker 8 thru 26. No where to turn around, I was forced to drive thru thus with a motorhome and tow vehicle. Not sure it is safe to continue with this product

title: So much better for us in our 38’ RV towing a car.
body: The program works a lot better and is more user friendly that “Trucker Path” free version. I like the overspeed warning. Update May 2022. I’m getting a little concerned about the routing. Recently it has tried to route me down a road that was too narrow and probably notStrong enough for the weight of our RV. Also, it is recommending a routing through the mountains that I know that our length of RV cannot do. I am hoping that this is just an aberration and not a new norm.

title: Update - BUYERS BEWARE DEGRADING QUALITY!
body: As I’ve stated in previous reviews, the quality of this app is degrading, and now I know why… Poor customer service, just like anything else in this country that starts out great. It turns out that my version of the app was out of date, and I had no clue. Most apps will inform you that you’re using an outdated version, but not this one. I had to uninstall the old version (losing all my previous trips), install the new version, which kept all the oldest trips, but oh well, things will be better now, right? Wrong! I went to Detroit, and the directions ran me around in circles. I wound up using a free app to get me there. Leaving Detroit, I was given wrong directions again - wrong exit number. Then leaving Iowa, going through construction on I-680 to I-80, it tells me to stay on route 218, then at the last minute, gives me directions to exit to I-80. I had a ticket open, and was constantly asked for feedback, which I gave when I had time. Then I was told to re-create the trip, save it as some type of file, and send it to them. Afterwards, I was told to uninstall the app AGAIN, and reinstall it AGAIN! Way too much hassle for a company that I don’t work for. They want their users to do ALL the work for them, so they can make the necessary improvements that THEY should already be working on, so they can still get paid. No thanks! Way too many other options.

title: User interface needs work
body: 1. User interface is clunky. 2. GPS gives address across the street - cannot easily modify. 3. GPS mode is prioritized over map view - give us a choice. 4. Cost is too high until these issues are fixed.

title: Worst update
body: Been a loyal user for 5 years, but this new update is horrible, I need to log in, accept privacy statement and restore my license every time I need to use the app. This was working 100% fine as an offline gps tool and now I can't use it unless there is connection !!!

title: Increasing disappointment
body: I wanted to make sure I use this app for longer than a year before I gave a review. I have taken 7x 12hr + plus trips and countless 2 to 8hr trips. The app has frozen on every trip involving my RV multiple times. I shouldn’t have to do a hard reset every time at random times during my trip. ilThe app has taking me down gravel roads and small neighborhood taking me off of main road just to get back on the main road, it has added an hour plus drive time due to its inner difficulties that I could not control or would have had to micromanage the trip as it was a in progress. Save your money and stress and find another app that utilizes rv towing

title: Doesnt work
body: Loaded it onto my iPad, filled in all required info,entered destination. It took me to a page that said "starting location". This was my destination, not start. Then it took me to a screen showing me in Africa. The directions never did show up.

title: Ram Pickup Carplay
body: I have a 2019 Ram 3500. Has no GPS system so use aps with gps. Have an I phone 12. Tried to load this program into carplay. Would not work. To bad. Will continue use Waze.

title: Needs Work
body: I made the purchase and literally canceled the very next day. I was still charged for the year subscription. However, what I didn’t like is that it’s not compatible with Apple Car Play which is a must these days. The second thing I didn’t like is that it took me on a road that was closed due to construction and once I passed my turned due to detour it kept rerouting me through small streets that I didn’t take because my RV is too big for those turns. So I had to go back to google maps. I mainly downloaded it so I can plug my RV height and width and get routes that my RV could go on but if it doesn’t recognize closed roads and it’s not compatible with Car Play really not worth it. Another problem I encountered is my RV is 13’6” and it would not accept those exact measurements even though it has the boxes asking for exact height so I had to put 14ft to be safe but that means I may be missing on a shorter route due to improper height on app. Was thinking of asking for a refund but not sure it’s worth the hassle.

title: Incorrect information on maps
body: Here’s what I’ve noticed after purchasing, using, and running this side by side with Google Maps. 1- The maps are outdated. For example, on the east coast there are large areas of freeway and highway that have changed their exit number (don’t know why) but this map shows the old number. Google shows the updated numbers. 2- more importantly, there were at least 2 instances where the map told me to take an exit that was incorrect. For example, it said “stay to the left and follow exit 6B when in fact I needed to take a cloverleaf hard right exit to get on to 6B. The illustration was incorrect and labeled the exit incorrectly. Got me in trouble twice which is why I keep Google maps on to double check the info. I bought this app to help guide my RV around low clearance bridges, etc. it has done that so far but with the correction help of Google. Overall not happy with this app and unfortunate that I paid for it. Update- Got a reply with a question mark at the end of a statement and a cookie cutter response. On the latest trip it kept routing me off the road to a small road that went right back to the road I was on. Wish I could just get my money back.

title: Mediocre at best
body: Missing a must have feature for any GPS app, support for Android auto and Apple CarPlay. Without Android auto or Apple CarPlay I can’t spend money on a gps app that is missing this feature.

title: Real time
body: This app should give real time traffic alerts accidents detours road closures if your gonna call yourself a trucker GPS google maps has bailed me out of situation this app has put me in on many occasions just wish they had an app for truckers you guys would be history

title: Can’t get app to recognize paid subscription
body: App works reasonably well. Although we have been routed down inappropriate roads occasionally, most of the time it has worked well. Unfortunately the app keeps telling me I need a paid subscription, which I already have, in order to use it. Can’t seem to figure out how to contact anyone to fix this, and very inconvenient when I need the app to work. Not satisfied.

title: Great features but no Carplay
body: Really like the app, had it for years. But the continued lack of Carplay support is really a deal breaker. That feature has been available in most major GPS apps for a few years now, and their ongoing support answer saying they're thinking about how to integrate it is simply frustrating at this point.

title: This GPS almost has it
body: I got this GPS because of the clear, easy-to-read screens, and downloadable maps, because I go into the mountains quite a bit where cell service goes away. HOWEVER, as a motorcycle rider, there are a few things that are frustrating: 1. The information in the corners on the bottom should be able to be moved to the top. It’s hard to read them on a cycle, as have to tip my head down too much. 2. Larger fonts, or at least bolder fonts. Makes it easier to see at a glance. 3. An easy way to stop the current route. Other GPS apps have a big red button to do this! I can’t be fishing around in a menu to find out how to cancel the route. 4. A way to pause the current route. If I take a detour, for example go to a rest stop, I don’t want the GPS bugging me, telling me to turn around.

title: Not good for NY NJ
body: No matter what vehicle you select you get directions to use parkways. No commercial traffic is allowed on parkways in NY and on some in NJ.

title: Very difficult to use
body: Not user friendly, perhaps if you’re a programmer you can figure this out. Way points do not display. If trying to create multi-trips, there is no info displayed on when you’ll arrive to the destination (leg 1 xx:xx; leg 2 xx:xx). This info could be helpful in planning. Cannot zoom out to see planed route. Again, would be helpful to plan route. Non-intuitive.

title: Customer support
body: If you need cuctomer support Just forget it

title: Problems.
body: Keeps asking me to upgrade whenever I already have a subscription. I tried to restore my purchases but then it forced closes to the main screen. Also whenever there are updates it erases all of my saved trips and it also logs me out and asked me to upgrade again whenever I already have a subscription. If there were something else closer to this app I probably would use it other than this one. Other than that is a pretty decent app for navigation.

title: Hot garbage
body: For an app that charges money for RV navigation, this is impressive hot garbage. First, the points of interest - I’m just checking this in Winnemucca, NV right off I-80. I’m missing the RV park that I’m currently in while testing, and worse, both the Flying J and Pilot stations are just not there. Non existent restaurants, restaurants which have been here for years, missing... The clunky 4 year old interface does not scale to iPhone 11 Pro Max? Are you kidding me? It’s called Xcode and Swift. Maybe your programmers should explore that someday. And let’s get to the grand fallacy - no CarPlay support. The last thing on their website is from 2018 saying they were looking at it. It’s been 2 years, folks! That’s inexcusable. I’m towing with a Ford, and it’s had CarPlay for at least three years back... I’m not giving that up. I’m sticking with Apple Maps and maybe Truck Maps while anywhere near Delaware and their weird tunnel restrictions. So to summarize- hot garbage, ancient non-updated interface, wildly inaccurate POI to the point of being inexcusable for anyone wanting to use this with a truck or an RV with a Good Sam membership, no CarPlay. Aaaaand, deleted app.

title: Inaccurate and dangerous to use!
body: We bought this for a road trip up the east coast since they tend to have low bridges and we were pulling a 44’ toy hauler. Despite knowing the length and height of our rv we were constantly taken off roads and put into situations that were very stressful and hard to navigate. We were even taken off of the toll parkway and then taken right back on requiring us to pay the $40 toll TWICE! I was navigated you take car only roads, off and back on the same roads multiple times, ridiculous! This app was extremely dangerous due to it not being able to go on our CarPlay. I often felt like I was blindly driving since it wasn’t safe to look down at this app. I ended up putting google on the car so I had some sort of direction. I’m super disappointed in this app. It did warn us of low bridges, otherwise it just added tons of unnecessary stress and cost us money!

title: It doesn’t support CarPlay
body: This is the biggest disadvantage. The screen of the phone is too small. Many people need to use navigation through Carplay.

title: Not a complete solution
body: I fully expected to see a category for “Truck Stops” to search for. The app allows me to enter the dimensions and weight of my vehicle which clearly indicates that it’s a big rig and not suitable for “gas stations”, but I order to find truck stops, I have to search by name. This app has had me so mad due to poor routing for my vehicle size, I’ve nearly thrown my iPad out the window! If I had a heart condition, I surely would have a heart attack by now. I truly have never been so mad as I’ve been as a result of learning to use this app and I’m a software developer by trade. This software is promising, but it lacks very important features that you would expect to find in a specialty app like this and in this price range. I still use it, but I do all my trip planning ahead of time and I consult two other apps to validate what this one recommends. If I find a replacement, I’ll happily delete this one!

title: Not user friendly
body: I used the app in hope it will make my first RV trip easy on me and guide me to the preferred routes for an RV. I tried to put the address of the camp site but the app didn’t find it so I used different navigation app. On my way back home from the camp site it did not recognize the location of the camp site at all. Maybe I set up the app wrong and that something the developer should work on. I would never rely on co pilot again in the future.

title: Breaks Password Manager
body: You are required to create an account on first launch to use the app. You can't use a password manager to create your account or input your password. Spent 10 mins trying, but the PW field won't accept pasted values & it doesn't trigger iOS as a password field. Most other apps figured this out long ago. I don't have time to manually manage & input complex passwords. Deleted without using the actual app itself.

title: Crashes on iPhone XR
body: Total fail. Had to drive through Chicago with just google maps and eyeballs in my huge RV. Thanks for nothing! 👎🏼

title: Switched devices and need help
body: I have switched device brands from android to iPhone and need help getting my user license back please. Sent an email yesterday and received a reply that does not solve my problem. Can someone please help me with this?

title: Used to love it...updated to junk
body: This used to be a pretty good gps for the truck although it had is quirks like wanting you to take off ramps and get right back on the interstate. Now to the latest update...they brag about optimizing the eta for stoplights and traffic but all they did is make it useless! I used to be able to look at the eta and add 15 minutes or so and be dead on and now it’s on average 3 to 4 hours off and is completely useless. At least my Rand McNally had the option to fine tune the eta to your driving style and I didn’t have to pay yearly for it. Also the maps are way out of date and never have newer addresses so I’m stuck using my phone when I get close to where I need to go

title: Works until you pay
body: I drive a refrigerated truck, got the 14 day free trial and it worked great. The day my trial ended and i started paying $10 the app would work until i got to my first stop, then it would freeze navigation. The app still functioned by it sees like gps was turned off. The route was still on the scree but your icon would not move according to your movement. Extremely frustrating being that you pay $10 a month for this service. Ive tried updating and redownloading the app. Nothing remedies.

title: App used to be great
body: I used to strictly use copilot for my navigation. It still works ok, but not great. Especially after I tried to upgrade to copilot subscription with RV and I don’t even have the option to purchase the subscription.

title: Copilot RV review after 1600 mile trip
body: I bought this thinking it would be a great app for RV GPS guidance. Well let me list the pros: Interface is good with traffic display Customize view RV set up Speed alerts * more on this issue with speed alerts Downloaded maps *. Issues below Search function is OK. Not bad but you have to enter city zip then enter address or name. Would be easier with just one search entry Cons. Download maps are not upgraded. We ran into many situations that my wife’s WAZE running at the same time saved us. Copilot had missed turns directly to RV spots and I entered the address to the spot. Missed turns on 2 locations that Waze saved us. The lane assist arrows are so small at the top of the iPhone you can’t see them especially in sun light. The speed alert went off so many times I turned it off. I am in a RV I don’t speed but it went off. Thought it might be me and raised the alert to 10mph over and still would go off at random times. Overall I can not trust the app which is why I bought it. We ended up using WAZE since we could not trust Copilot. Overall a 2 but it has promise just not there yet.

title: Not as expected
body: Copilot does not work through my Bluetooth headset as hoped. Also it does not route me based on my vehicle size. It places me in U-turn situations that can not be done based on my vehicle profile. $30 wasted.

title: Frustrating
body: I am a CDL driver. I decided to test this application. I have had a major issue with it directing me to take an exit. I get off at the exit only to re enter into the same road I was just on. This application has cost me time I can not depend on it. It allowed me to configure my route with the possible routes. I will set it how I want to go and then start navigation. Well during the trip at some point it will change corse to what ever it sees’ fit. I almost paid for this, I’m glad I didn’t. It does have features that I like. Just the couple of issues I have had make it not worth my money.

title: So Disappointed
body: We had high hopes for this as we had difficulties with low bridges and RV unfriendly routes on our last trip. But 1st time iut with this app it took us straight to a closed road and then wanted to route us down THREE roads that were designated “No Trucks” in our 31.5’ motorhome. What’s up with THAT?!!

body: Worst gps I have tried for RVs. Can’t even locate Nashville TN. Route planning is useless

title: Needs so many improvements
body: Off line maps of the world, that’s the good part. And not much else. Login never works on certain device. You can’t copy paste the long password. You can’t make it visible either so you don’t know if you have typed it correct either. You can’t use copied address. Constantly bugs me about the notifications to turn on....

title: Ha!!!
body: Let’s see... I tested this app for my 18 wheeler and my personal car. Both versions had several things wrong. Mostly speeds were wrong. With my personal car version? It would always try to make me enter truck parking areas and exit interstates. Only to tell me to immediately get back onto the interstates. “How stupid can a developer be?!?”, I thought to myself. Well, with the way this app functions? The answer is... A developer can be just as stupid as the amount of money he/she may try to steal from people, for a horrible app. Just like this one. Do not waste your money on this app.

title: Is developer open to user comments for improvements?
body: I drive a truck and I am frequently in the northeast where there are many low bridges and truck restriction routes. So I need quality info. So far I find Copilot clumsy. I still run Google Maps simultaneously to ensure I take the right or best route. I got a ticket in NY as approached the Midtown Tunnel after Copilot directed me to miss my exit from the Long Island Expressway to the BQE because it changed my route without asking me or alerting me. This mistake sent me toward the tunnel, which I knew I could not take. I was looking for a way out. Fortunately the cops helped me out of a jam, but gave me a ticket in the process. Here are my specific issues. Co pilot problems 1. Changes route without asking me or letting me know 2. Highway and city names too small to read. Does not get larger when I zoom in. 3. Has routed me on some routes that are clearly not truck routes and physically impossible for a truck (and yes, my profile has 53’ trailer with 13’6” height). 4. Algorithms find very convoluted routes that are inefficient, jump off highways and add unnecessary miles and time, and finds routes that go right through traffic with lots of intersections and lights. 5. Often picks a route in the opposite direction with a u-turn to get back on track. 6. Does not know how to control the play/pause function when connected to radio/speakers. Often goes silent. Causes me to miss turns/exits because of #1 above. 7. Too many colors and not clearly identified routes, worse in night mode. Look at Google and iMaps. Very clear. 8. When I try to force it to take a specific route, rather than going direct through the desired route, it goes through the original route, then back-tracks and adds lots of twists. I would appreciate info as to what developer is doing to fix these problems, or I have search for another app, especially since I am paying for this Trucker GPS. I really need an effective and efficient trucker GPS, especially in the northeast where getting off route can be very dangerous. If this one doesn’t get fixed, I have to search for another. Paying $10 a month for an app that I have to constantly second guess doesn’t cut it.

Also, the scroll moves extremely fast. which makes it difficult to not make an accident and move pass the location or item you’re looking for. Please fix thanks!

title: Pay to drive

Trucker Path has apple car play support so the gps map shows up on your entertainment system screen. Co Pilot needs to go the same route! Also CoPilot needs to update the posted speed limits.

title: HUGE SAFETY CONCER WITH AUDIO
body: This app works pretty good for the most part. Our company uses it to help us navigate our oversized loads and it does good for the most part. We deliver trusses to job sites that tractor trailers are not supposed to be in, such as log cabins in the mountains of Highlands, NC, to Lake houses around Norther Georgia & this app always tries to find the best way for us to get there. My only complaint is the audio. It has a HUGE bug on IPhone where if you are having the maps on unmuted, it keeps loosing audio. There is a huge list of things that cause this issue such as: using Siri, if you answer a phone call, if you make a phone call, if you connect to your truck stereo, if you connect any Bluetooth device such as AirPods or trucking headset, if you disconnect from any Bluetooth device. You literally have to close the app out SEVERAL times and redo your navigation and hope that the audio comes back on after the 8th time of you doing it. Hitting the “Mute/ Unmute button” does not help at all to get your audio back. This is a huge safety concern especially when you are hauling tractor trailers that the trailer alone is 75 feet long or can reach up to 16 feet wide requiring us to have Police escorts and regular escort vehicles with us in a convoy. If I relied on this app and didn’t use two other GPS devices at the same time, it would cause me to mess up quite a lot just from the audio issue alone. With loads that big, I can not afford to keep taking my eyes off the road and keep touching my phone to make sure that the app didn’t loose the audio. I love the app but please fix the audio issue. I have been using it for close to a year and have always had this issue. Today it caused me to mess up big time, I missed my turn because I had connected my airpods and lost audio. Causing me to have to get a road shut down, and close to five thousand dollars for a few big wreckers to come help me out of the situation. This was the only GPS I could rely on and it let me down today. Please fix this issue.
